tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory. Also bidders shall not be blacklisted by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD shall be furnished as prescribed in the tender document. Tender processing fee paid is not refundable by the Department.
Samples shall be submitted as per Section II, Instruction to Tenderers, clause 7.2 of the tender document.
Prices shall be quoted all inclusive at E-portal. Prices quoted in the E-portal will only be Considered for Evaluation.
Please refer Section V and Section VI of the Tender Documents for Details and Specifications.

All terms and conditions are applicable as per the tender document. Also the updates of KTPP and rules made there under as on published date. Any amendments shall only be published in e-procurement portal only.
All documents related to tender shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The manufacturer or the trader shall be in the business at least from past Three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should be a manufacturer or an authorized dealer/ agent of the manufacturer (Now onwards called as Authorized Agent) who has experience in executing such contracts.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall have average annual turnover as per the following (1) Art Board Gloss / Matt - 58.00 Lakhs and (2) Art Printing Paper Gloss / Matt - 58.00 Lakhs (During the last three preceding assessment year 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26) Whereas for Micro and Small Enterprises the average annual turnover shall be 50% of the estimated cost for every schedule for the last two preceding financial years. Which will be verified from the Annual returns of GST submitted as mentioned in clause 7.1 of ITT if required.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative of a manufacturer, meeting with the above requirement in full, can also be considered provided (i) The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance in proforma under Section XI.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A detailed description on prescribed technical specification and performance characteristics of the goods and company test reports shall be furnished If there is any relevant printed document or soft copy of the document may also be submitted. The website address - URL if any may please be indicated.
Acknowledgement of IT returns filed for the previous three years - AY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

Authorization letter from the concerned manufacturer shall be submitted by the nondealer/ manufacturers preferably in the format given in Section XII to participate in the tender - Authorization letter shall be in specific for the tender and as per schedule wise whichever applicable and participating Or Where ever the manufacturer himself is participating in the tender, a declaration that he is a manufacturer shall be provided.
BIS details for the participating Item.
Compliance Statement as per Section XIV.
Copies of Latest GST returns filed.
Copies of Registration Certificate of GST.
Copy of the acknowledgement for submitted samples shall be uploaded.
Declaration stating that the tenderer has read & understood all the terms and conditions of the tender document.
Declaration stating the rates quoted in the e-portal is inclusive of all - Refer Section VIII Tender Form and Price Schedule NOTE of the tender document.
Declaration that the turnover clause as specified in the qualification criteria shall be fulfilled.
Declaration to the extent of compliance or abide for the tender conditions.
Declaration to the extent of EMD submission with Respect to Participating Item
Declarations vide Annexure 1 and 2 regarding bidders of a country sharing land border with India.
Information about the Rates of GST applicable for the participating items - SGST & CGST or IGST whichever is applicable.
PAN copy of the tenderer.
Performa for Performance Statement shall be filled by bidder in the form given in Section XI - Performance Statement.

The Organizations /bidders participating in the tender must be from Karnataka or from the states sharing borders with the State of Karnataka, namely Tamil Nadu, Keralam, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Goa.
The Organizations/bidders participating in the tender must submit a declaration regarding the establishment of their office/divisional office in Bengaluru or near Bengaluru.
The Price by the bidder shall be fixed for the contract period.
